summary: [¶] - d) The Commission erred in the impugned order by refusing condonation of delay. In paragraph 59 of the impugned order, the Commission noted that ‘there was no stay on the order dated 25.10.2021 in CWP Nos. 19391 of 2020 and 5181 of 2021’. However, despite no explicit stay on the order dated 25.10.2021 in CWP Nos. 19391 of 2020 and 5181 of 2021, the Hon'ble High Court’s judgment explicitly stated that transmission lines should not be laid before the relocation of the temporary huts of labourers/workers on the site, which is to be facilitated by the Review Petitioner in the same premises of the landowner. This effectively resulted in a stay, as the Review Petitioner could not proceed with the construction of the transmission towers until the temporary huts of labourers/workers were relocated. Consequently, it effectively imposed a stay on the commencement of tower construction activities, i.e., 16.12.2022, the date of final disposal of LPA Nos. 1115, 1116 and 1121 by the Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana. The Commission also recognised this in paragraph 53 of its order dated 23.09.2024. Despite recognising the same, the Commission did not consider condoning the delay from 20.11.2021 to 16.12.2022 in paragraph 59 of the impugned order, and the same constitutes an error apparent on the face of the record. [para 8] 8. The Review Petitioner has contended that vide the impugned order dated 23.09.2024, the Commission approved the COD of the transmission assets as 24.3.2023 and condoned the delay of 1214 days out of 1504 days as claimed by it. It has mainly contended that in paragraph 59 of the impugned order dated 23.9.2024, the Commission observed that there was no stay on the order dated 25.10.2021 in CWP Nos. 29391 of 2020 and 5181 of 2021, though no such explicit stay was there in the order dated 25.10.2021, even then the observation of the Hon’ble High Court in the order dated 25.10.2021 that the transmission lines shall not be laid down before relocation of the temporary huts of the labourers/workers on the spot resulted in an effective stay on construction activities of the Review Petitioner. As such, the period of non-condonation of delay from 20.11.2021 to 16.12.2022 for the transmission assets, being an error apparent on record, is liable to be condoned. Besides this, it has been contended that in the LPA Nos. 1115, 1116 and 1121, which were filed by the landowners challenging the order dated 25.10.2021, an interim order passed on 1.6.2022. However, this was not considered by the Commission in the impugned order. [para 15] 15. In paragraph 53 of the impugned order, the facts concerning the orders dated 22.10.2020 and 9.11.2020 of the District Magistrate being challenged before the Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana in CWP Nos.19391 of 2020 and 5181 of 2021 on 4.3.2021, are recorded. This paragraph also discusses the District Magistrate’s said orders being affirmed by the Hon’ble High Court vide judgment dated 25.10.2021 in the said CWPs, with the observation that the Petitioner shall not lay the transmission line before the relocation of the temporary huts of the labourers. This paragraph further speaks about a Committee formed [para 16] 16. Perusal of paragraph 53 of the impugned order clearly records a finding that no documentary evidence has been given for the delay that occurred between 26.5.2022 and 19.12.2022, and due to this reason, the delay was not condoned for this period.
